test_periodically: test the periodically function to verify it calls a body function every N steps
test_period_one: test the periodically function with period=1 to verify it runs every step
test_period_none: test the periodically function with period=None to verify it never runs
test_function_not_callable: test the periodically function raises TypeError when body is not callable
create_periodic_update: create a periodic update operation that executes a body function every N steps
